remarks: This pristine townhouse is located close to the DELAMAR Hotel, MetroNorth & all that downtown living offers. Inside you will enjoy tall ceilings, natural light, top of the line fixtures & finishes including an elevator to whisk you from underground parking to an impressive rooftop deck w/ water views. The living room features gas fireplace & flows to the dining room. The kitchen is equipped for a serious cook looking to spread out & prepare a special meal. Upstairs begins w/ an impressing Masterbedroom suite & two terrific guest bedrooms - all w/ luxurious baths & spacious closets. The top floor, equipped w/wet bar is equipped for memorable gatherings - 4th of July fireworks? Direct water access for kayaks & more! This is one of a kind! Do not miss the virtual tour link for a video showing. One year lease or longer. Pets are negotiable with an excellent application. Fresh paint throughout.  Occupancy 5/1/2025 +/-
